title: Paper
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: LCL RPG style exploration round03, fourth study "Paper".
Create a BRAND NEW traditional watercolor painting from this written scene description, with a radically simple painting language. Dark expressive watercolor, broad large uneven tonal washes, highly visible paper tooth, pigment blooms, rough tide lines, soft ragged lost edges. Sparse ink only where a contour is necessary for a person or interactive object. Paint EACH object in just a few broad strokes; industrial machines are blocky readable silhouettes, NEVER finely outlined bolts, individual tiny rails, wires or seams. This is hand-painted adult illustration rather than CGI or a texture-overlaid render. Keep dark shadow masses and unpainted warm gray paper as active compositional shapes. Charcoal-deep freight shadows, umber-gray stone, muted rusty pigment accents. Scarce warm amber washes ONLY in human nooks and around existing practical lights; most station is cold and somber. Crisp enough key silhouettes to navigate, deliberately abstract machinery.
Scene: occupied municipal freight station seen in elevated three-quarter OVERHEAD oblique/trimetric nearparallel projection, no horizon and no strong vanishingpoints. Left side upper gallery and staircase down to floor; beneath gallery in upperleft is a simple repair workbench and ONE standing repairer in a tiny amber light pool. Lowerleft is a bench with a woven cushion and ONE seatedhuman, a small tea table and a single modest pottedplant. Tall concretepier near center has mounted dispenser, relaypanel and small amberlamp. ONE waiting traveler stands just before a CLOSED transparentglass accessgate midright. Right side is continuous maintained freight infrastructure: straight rails, freightcontainer cars and an overheadgantrycrane. Exactlythree people total. Machines dark iron, simple shapes, functional. Concrete piers establish height; wide empty walkable floor shapes keep human area legible.
Composition: landscape16:9, continuous grounded playfield cropped so floor, gallery and freight infrastructure extend beyond imageedges. Consistent parallel-like scale, elevated Fallout1/2-type gameplay camera. No floating island/diorama edge. Gate closed, no crossing. No extra props or plants, no fire or sparks, no monsters, no cinematic horizon or lens, no photorealism or 3D shading, no UI/borders/writing/watermark. The ambition is radical reduction in mechanical detail while retaining every major scene anchor.

conceptualParents.role: Broad expressive watercolor and narrative station anchors, described in words only

observedFeatures.palette: Umber gray / charcoal / muted rust / amber

observations: New painting with no image inputs. Floor and columns become larger broad tonal washes; freight is darker iron with blocky machinery. Exactly three people, clear central walkable area, closed glass gate and all key scene categories. Amber warmth remains concentrated near bench/repair/central lamps.
styleDrift: Less detailed than original station and detailed Embers, but still has distinct stair treads, container ribs, rail ties and train undercarriage. Radical abstraction only partially achieved; remains medium detail rather than a near-abstract few-stroke sketch.
layoutDrift: Semantic scene retained but camera framing and object spacing newly composed. Stair shifts to far left; workbench beneath gallery; plant stands on floor beside tea table; freight includes extra cars/track lanes. Bench has a woven surface but no distinctly separate decorative cushion. Central pier/relay/dispenser, closed glass gate and three people retained.
